description_expanded: SummaryWelcome to this pet-friendly retreat in the new Hawks Landing community of Santa Rosa Beach. This 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom townhome is just under 4 miles from the emerald waters of the Gulf and offers easy access to the best of 30A. Enjoy a well-equipped kitchen, an open-concept living area, and a private patio with a gas grill. Whether you're relaxing at the beach, exploring local dining, or biking along 30A, this townhome is the perfect home base.njoy easy access to beaches, dining, and outdoor activities along Scenic Highway 30A.SpaceWelcome to "B Coastal" located in the new neighborhood of Hawks Landing in Santa Rosa Beach. Your pet-friendly coastal retreat awaits! Experience the brand-new Townhome at Hawk's Landing, an exclusive townhome community nestled just under four miles from the sparkling Gulf of Mexico. Located in the desirable Santa Rosa Beach area, this inviting community offers a perfect mix of luxury, convenience, and coastal charm for those seeking a vacation getaway. The spacious 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom townhome is designed with comfort and style in mind. This newly completed unit features a thoughtful floor plan with all bedrooms on the second level, providing an open and airy main floor that is perfect for family gatherings, entertaining, or simply relaxing. The townhome comfortably accommodates up to 8 guests with a queen bed in the primary, a second queen in the guest room, and two twin beds in the third bedroom, plus a sleeper sofa offers additional flexibility for larger groups. Step inside and be greeted by beautiful EVP flooring throughout. The main living space boasts 9-foot ceilings and a spacious layout that flows seamlessly into a gourmet kitchen with a center island, white cabinetry, and stunning granite countertops. Equipped with stainless steel appliances—including a smooth top stove, microwave, and dishwasher—this kitchen is a chef’s dream, whether you’re preparing a quick breakfast, a picnic for the beach, or a delicious family dinner. Step out and explore everything this charming area has to offer! "B Coastal" is surrounded by a delightful array of eateries, cafes, cozy coffee spots, and weekly farmer’s markets. For boating enthusiasts, Cessna Landing, which is a county park on Highway 393, just 1.5 miles away, offers easy bay access for launching your boat, as well as docks, picnic shelters, basketball and squash court as well as a playground. Spend your days kayaking, paddle boarding, or just soaking up the sun along Scenic Hwy 30-A—famous for its stunning coastline and laid-back atmosphere. Come and make "B Coastal" your vacation haven! We'd love to host you (and your dog - pet fee applies). SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 8) - PRIMARY BEDROOM: 2nd Floor, Queen bed, ensuite bath with walk in shower - QUEEN BEDROOM: 2nd Floor, Queen bed, shared hall bath with tub/shower combination - TWIN BEDROOM: 2nd Floor, 2 Twin beds, shared hall bath with tub/shower combination - LIVING AREA: 1st Floor, Sofa Bed FEATURES: - 3 Bedrooms/2.5 Bathrooms - Pet Friendly - Gas grill - Wireless internet - Fully appointed kitchen - Full sized appliances, including washer and dryer - Close to Cessna Landing (1.5 miles away) with boat launch BEACH ACCESS: - Closest is Ed Walline (3.8 miles away)NeighborhoodHawks Landing, Santa Rosa BeachNotesWe love dogs and are happy to provide a dog friendly space for your vacation! However, it's important to note that dogs are not allowed on any of the beaches along 30A. There is a dog beach at Pier Park located at 16303 Front Beach Rd. Panama City Beach where Fido can meet some new friends and enjoy our gorgeous Emerald Coast! Please note that county quiet hours begin at 10pm.House Rules1. Smoking is NOT allowed inside the Rental Property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged to guests if smoking inside Rental Property occurs or evidence is found of smoking inside. 2. People other than included in the Guest Count may not stay in the property. Any other person on Rental Property is the sole responsibility of Guest. 3. Quiet Hours are 10pm – 8am. Excessive noise inside these hours are not permitted and will result in eviction and cancellation with no refund. 4. Rental Property is privately owned; Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the Rental Property or its facilities. The Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the Guest and Rental Party. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that Guests and Rental Party are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the Rental Property or others whom they invite to use the Rental Property. 5. Guest agrees to keep the property and all furnishings in good order and only use appliances for their intended uses. 6. Pets are only allowed with Owners/Property Managers prior approval. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged and the Guest will be evicted/ Pet fees may apply. 7. Housekeeping: There is no daily housekeeping service. While linens and bath towels are included in the unit, daily maid service is not included in the rental rate. We do not permit towels or linens to be taken from the property unless used for amenities outside the property such as shared hot tub and pool areas. Please return the linens in the Property after use. 8. Water and Septic: The septic system is very effective; however, it will clog up if improper material is flushed. DO NOT FLUSH anything other than toilet paper. No feminine products should be flushed at any time. If it is found that feminine products have been flushed and clog the septic system, you will be charged for any damages incurred by Property Manager or Owner. 9. Renter(s) are responsible for themselves, their family and guests at all times. Children should be supervised at all times. 10. If Rental Party exceeds the maximum occupancy Guest will be asked to leave the Rental Property with no refunds. Infants under 2 years are not counted. 11. At least one parent or adult must be present at all times when children under the age of 16 are in the Rental Property or using any of outdoor facilities such as Hot Tub. 12. Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for money, jewelry, or other valuables lost, stolen, or left behind in the Rental Property, but will use their best effort to remedy the situation. 13. No rowdy behavior is permitted. Guests must behave at all times, in a reasonable and proper manner and act in a way as to protect the Rental Property, its contents and furnishings against damage. Failure to do so could result in eviction. 14. No subletting of the Rental Property or assigning of this agreement is permitted. 15. Please note that we charge per guest after a set number. Please provide the entire group count in your reservation request. If an update to the group count is needed after confirming the reservation, the reservation cost may increase. 16. Guest must obtain approval prior to checking in early or check out late. If Guest enter the Rental Property before agreed upon Check In Time or leave the Rental Property after agreed upon Check Out Time, Guest will be charged $50/half hour. 17. Guest is responsible to learn and understand any mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19 before confirming a reservation. 18. Guest agrees that they are 25 years of age or older. 19. If applicable, Guest may be responsible for loss of any parking passes/permits in amounts up to $400 per pass/permit. 20. Emotional Support Animals (ESA) are not allowed unless explicitly approved by Owner/Manager. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged to the Guest and Guest will be evicted. 21. Bicycles must yield to pedestrians when riding on sidewalks. Use designated crosswalks and follow all traffic laws. 22. Helmets are required for riders under 16. Nighttime riding requires a front light and rear reflectors for visibility. 23. Only licensed and insured drivers may operate golf carts and low-speed vehicles (LSVs). 24. Golf carts and LSVs must follow Florida motor vehicle laws and may only be driven on roads with speed limits of 35 mph or less. 25. Golf carts and LSVs may not be driven on sidewalks or bike paths. Working headlights and taillights are required for nighttime use. 26. Bicycles must be locked when parked and marked with identification for return. Guests are responsible for any loss, theft, or damage during the rental. 27. Golf cart and LSV drivers must ensure all passengers wear seatbelts and do not exceed passenger limits. 28. Reckless driving or unauthorized modifications to golf carts and LSVs is prohibited. Park responsibly and return vehicles clean and fully charged or refueled. 29. LSVs and bicycles are not allowed within the Rosemary Beach Community. 30. Guests are responsible for any fines, tickets, or damages incurred during use. Bicycles and golf carts/LSVs must be returned in the same condition as provided. 31. Guests acknowledge the inherent risks of using bicycles and operating golf carts/LSVs. 32. Guests agree to indemnify and hold harmless LocalVR, its owners, and employees from any claims or damages arising from use. 33. LocalVR and the property owner are not liable for injuries or damages incurred, except in cases of gross negligence or willful misconduct. Read Less
